name: Los Angeles
industries: Entertainment and streaming, aerospace, port logistics and healthcare give LA America's most diversified project market.
intro:
Los Angeles runs projects across more industries than any other American city: studios and streamers producing content at industrial scale, the ports of San Pedro Bay moving 40% of US imports, aerospace primes and SpaceX in the South Bay, and healthcare systems serving ten million people. That breadth means both flavors of credential pay: PMP in aerospace, logistics and healthcare; Scrum certifications across entertainment tech and the Silicon Beach scene. Batches are scheduled live online across the whole year at hours built for Los Angeles: a weekend Sat–Sun cohort and a weekday Wed–Thu cohort each week, all landing in comfortable local daytime; every upcoming date and its exact Los Angeles timing is listed in the schedule below. Either way: one weekend, live instruction, exam application support, realistic mocks, trainer access until you pass.

Los Angeles delivers projects that ship on air dates and launch windows: studios and streamers run content and technology programs simultaneously, aerospace primes in the South Bay run decade-long governed portfolios, and the port complex adds continuous infrastructure work. Certification translates across all three — the same governance language from El Segundo to Burbank. The course runs live online over two consecutive days shown in Los Angeles local time on this page, sparing you the 405 entirely. LA compensation for certified project professionals varies by industry more than by title; the sourced entries below give dated figures per source. The employer list shows the entertainment-aerospace-logistics mix, and studios can certify production-technology teams through private cohorts.

faq.q: What are the class timings in Los Angeles?
faq.a: Live classes run 09:00 AM – 06:00 PM CT, which is 07:00 AM – 04:00 PM PDT in Los Angeles. You can pick a weekend (Sat–Sun) or a weekday (Wed–Thu) cohort; each completes the course over two consecutive days.

faq.a: All batches are 100% live online, taught by an instructor over video with interactive exercises — there is no venue to travel to in Los Angeles. You need a laptop, a stable connection and a free weekend.

faq.q: Is the certificate different if I attend from United States?
